## Problem

A short description of the user problem this feature would solve.

## Proposed solution

How the feature would work from the LLM's perspective (input / output
examples are perfect).

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches you considered and why this one is better.

## Compatibility impact

Does the change affect the MCP protocol, the existing tool signatures,
or the install/upgrade path?

## Additional context

Any related issues, references, or screenshots.
